description: When implementation files change, ask the agent to check the GrimBranch spec task list and confirm every finished task is checked off with its requirement still satisfied.
name: Spec task check-off reminder

then.prompt: Review .kiro/specs/grimbranch/tasks.md against the current state of the code. For each task that is now complete, check it off. If a change broke a requirement in .kiro/specs/grimbranch/requirements.md, say which one and stop.
